capabilities: Manage GTD tasks from a single main task page
Perform every task action with keyboard shortcuts
Reduce friction in task capture and processing
Let other plugins and scripts interact with tasks via an API
Use tasks across multiple devices with v2
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin store; it is pending review and must be installed through BRAT. Full documentation is hosted elsewhere, not in the README.
motivation: The author loved MyLifeOrganized and used it for years, and wanted a similar experience inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structured GTD workflow for capturing, organizing, and acting on tasks from one keyboard-driven interface.

relations.evidence: If you’ve ever used MyLifeOrganized, the UI will be immediately familiar.

summary: Keyboard-first GTD task management system with a single main task interface, full keyboard control, and an API for other plugins.
